name: Password Manager Pro Pam Provider
description: The Password Manager Pro PAM extension allows for the retrieval of account usernames and passwords

Parameters.Name: Host
Parameters.Description: The IP address or URL of the PMP instance, including any port number

Parameters.Name: Authtoken
Parameters.Description: The access token for the PMP Api user.

Parameters.Name: resourceName
Parameters.Description: The Resource Name of the secret to retrieve as displayed in PMP

Parameters.Name: accountName
Parameters.Description: The Account Name of the secret to retrieve as displayed in PMP

Parameters.Name: LookupType
Parameters.Description: Must be either Username or Password. Defines which value the extension should retrieve
